predictions: Another strong week (not quite like the 20-win records in two of the last three weeks, but still good). Popped a little 17-6 last week in what was really an incredible slate of week 7 matches. I don't know how the Membership Director does it, but that first half ended with a huge set of big matches, and they delivered serious drama. More than half of the matches could've flipped or tied on a single dart! And I nailed a big pile of them exactly, including a tiebreaker (which I admit I would have rather gotten wrong…). Anyway, up to 122-39 for the season.

Match of the week: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Hump Day! The D division race has shaken out into a set of 4 Haves and 3 Have-nots, with a stunningly clear line between the groups. Among the Haves, two of the four sit a match ahead of the other pair, and here we go kicking off the second half of the season with the head-to-head drama at the top. Since Deemer doesn't seem to play anymore… M2S, 13-11.

Match #2: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Village Idiots. Oh, the E race is a glorious pile of messy awesomeness. Four 4-2s and a 3-3 that isn't even really behind on points. This… is… fantastic. And of course the second half of the season is going to start things with a pairing of the top two! This one went all the way to 1001 last time, and it's going to again!! But this time, the Machine cranks out a win.

Match #3: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Show Me Your Tips. The absolute pasting that Show Me laid on Raging back in week 1 feels like a lifetime ago. Half a season later, these are the two teams sitting two matches behind Darty Minds, so this kinda feels like it might be an elimination match in the battle to see who is the one true challenger in B. How do these teams have 3 losing doubles set records between them?! I think Raging is going to find some doubles here finally! Raging, 13-11.

Match #4: (F Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Sofa Kings. Corks had a couple guys miss last Wednesday and got thrashed by a 1-win team, so the F race might well still be wide open. If so, this battle between the 2nd and 3rd place teams might all of a sudden be critical in determining how F goes down. Dart Side continues their narrow-win streak, 13-11.

Match #5: (G Div.) Killer Dee's @ Nein Mark. Nein Mark has been handling business like a champ, and they're already getting close to chasing down a title clinching date. If they can knock off another of the top three for the second week in a row, that is. They can, 14-10.

Match #6: (C Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Nine Lives. The Niners are exactly where the Niners live… in the middle, at roughly 0.500, with a serious chance to win or lose every single night, regardless of opponent. The Bandits had better pay attention. Bandits, 13-11.

Match #7: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Ton 80 Proof. At first glance, this would look like it's just Ton 80's next step on the way to being in the main E title fight. But the Irish just knocked Death Throw out of 1st, so Ton 80 better figure out how to win a DCkt right now. T80, 14-10.

Match #8: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ The Rock Bottoms. If the RDL expands back to an H div. next season, somehow at least one of the quite decent 3-3 and 2-4 G teams could drop. Time to win matches within that group and move up, no? The Bottoms are rolling, 15-9.

Match #9: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Off Constantly-Reboot. I'm betting these two weren't expecting (and certainly not hoping) to be duking it out to avoid a bottom-two spot and possible drop to D in the spring. I'm guessing Sanchez ends their big recent slide, 14-10.
Match #10: (B Div.) Iceman's @ Double In, Uber Out. With B having one team way ahead and one way behind, the middle six could still end up in almost any order. Where's Page? Ice, 13-11.
Match #11: (F Div.) Bangin The Wire @ That's What She Said. Bangin has hung within striking distance in a very under-the-radar way so far. Now they get She Said off their big win. Wire, 13-11.
And the remaining 12 matches, sorted by division:
